    from sys import stdin, stdout

    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    T = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        N = int(input[index])
        index += 1
        P = list(map(int, input[index:index + N]))
        index += N
        cost = 0
        operations = []
        visited = [False] * N
        for i in range(N):
            if visited[i] or P[i] == i + 1:
                continue
            cycle = []
            x = i
            while not visited[x]:
                visited[x] = True
                cycle.append(x)
                x = P[x] - 1
            for j in range(len(cycle) - 1):
                cost += abs(cycle[j] - cycle[j + 1])
                operations.append((cycle[j] + 1, cycle[j + 1] + 1))
            if len(cycle) > 1:
                cost += abs(cycle[-1] - cycle[0])
                operations.append((cycle[-1] + 1, cycle[0] + 1))
        results.append(f"{cost}\n{len(operations)}\n" + "\n".join(f"{a} {b}" for a, b in operations))
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(results))

main()
